title: Unit
description: A standard quantity in which a measure is expressed (CR-5 §9/Phase 2); percent, ratio, months, currency, count. Referenced by measures; never embedded in names.

id.description: Stable OpenDEA identifier (CR-3Q). Type prefix: dea:unit-

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

dimensionality.description: The dimensionality of the Unit (CR-MET-005). Time, length, mass, currency, count, temperature, information quantity, rate, ratio, dimensionless index, or composite.

ucum_code.description: Reference to the Unified Code for Units of Measure (UCUM) for this Unit. The canonical UCUM data is held externally per CR-MET-005 section 2.2; this field is a reference handle, not the table.

conversion_to_base_factor.description: The multiplicative factor for conversion to the base Unit of the same dimensionality (e.g. minutes -> seconds: 60).

conversion_to_base_offset.description: The additive offset for conversion to the base Unit of the same dimensionality (e.g. Celsius -> Kelvin: -273.15 inverted as +273.15).

composite_dimensions.description: For Units with dimensionality: composite; the dimensional components with their exponents (e.g. velocity = distance / time -> [{dimensionality: length, exponent: 1}, {dimensionality: time, exponent: -1}]). Optional; informational warning (not a conformance failure) when absent for a composite Unit.

relationships.description: Derived convenience view (CR-1/CR-3): canonical relationship instances are authoritative.
